dcterms:title: MCP request and response
dcterms:description: Use for MCP/API behavior. Capture the exact prompt or request and actual before/after replies against the same data. Label local, replayed and production observations.
robos:collectionInstructions: Use for MCP/API behavior. Capture the exact prompt or request and actual before/after replies against the same data. Label local, replayed and production observations.

dcterms:title: Product UI before and after
dcterms:description: Use for visible product behavior. Capture real screens before and after the same action, plus the browser assertions.
robos:collectionInstructions: Use for visible product behavior. Capture real screens before and after the same action, plus the browser assertions.

dcterms:title: Command and output
dcterms:description: Use for CLI and backend changes. Capture the command, its output before and after, exit status and tested revision.
robos:collectionInstructions: Use for CLI and backend changes. Capture the command, its output before and after, exit status and tested revision.

dcterms:title: Task checks and artifacts
dcterms:description: Use for tasks without a useful before/after comparison. Capture actual execution output for each acceptance check.
robos:collectionInstructions: Use for tasks without a useful before/after comparison. Capture actual execution output for each acceptance check.
